additional_info.subject: ID0384376-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R3 170001681] OCPP Clock Aligned Meter value. CRM:00643000991
additional_info.body:
Dear Edna,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R3 170001681
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
R1G8Ft
Problem Description
: OCPP Clock Aligned Meter value.
Troubleshooting
:
The ClockAlignedMeter Value does not correlate with the DC meter. The Energy.Active.Import.Interval & Energy.Active.Import.Register are related to the DC meter. In our charger, the meter value aligned data is a required field in the S-D charger, but no other values are supported. If you have any further queries regarding this matter, please let us know. Otherwise, we will proceed with closing this ticket.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0384376
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
